items.text: On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; changed hook scripts need renewed trust.
Context recording needs a status-line command in your own host settings: setup previews one, or gives a recipe when you already have a status line.
The separate scan-agents, set-mode and setup-instructions skills are gone: use /setup scan, /setup mode and /setup instructions. /setup check lists files that still name them.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the session-start hook changed.
The Parallel lines in ## Limits of host.md are no longer read: set the limit again in each repository, then delete those lines by hand and keep the rest of ## Limits.
The away session (/afk) needs its settings recorded first; skip this if you do not use it.
Delegation can record which task levels (1 easy to 5 ultra hard) each helper takes; setup now asks this as part of the assignment matrix.
Move ## Agent roles and ## Agent levels into the assignment matrix: setup runs matrix_setup.py migrate, shows what it drops and asks your consent again.
fnl-ask is now help (on Claude Code type /finolabs-vibecode:help). The old name works only when you type it; instruction files must name help.
The away session can now decide some questions itself: setup asks which kinds of decision stop it, optional non-production targets and a separate excerpt consent.
On Claude Code a new hook holds the question tool during a live away lease; trust the plugin's changed hooks if Claude Code asks.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the hook scripts changed.
The verification skill is now called checks, and /verification keeps working as an alias until 0.3.0.
Run /setup add checks to save a check list per repository, with the optional local receipt and pre-push hook.
The same setup step can write, after a previewed yes, a cheaper CI workflow that runs on pull requests and skips document-only changes.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again.
A check list saved with 0.2.4 is no longer read: run /setup add checks again in each repository, then delete the old ## Checks section from host.md by hand.
Parallel limits in host.md are no longer read: set parallel and caps again in each repository before you delete ## Project settings by hand.
Settings in host.md are no longer read: set them again in each repository, then delete ## Project settings and the Ledger project: and Task file: lines by hand.
Labels in host.md are no longer read: set each again inside each repository, then delete the ## Project labels section by hand.
Skills lost the fnl- prefix (fnl-setup is now setup). Old names work only when typed; instruction files must use the new names. /setup check lists each old name with its new one.
/autopilot is now /afk and the ## Autopilot section of host.md is no longer read: run /setup add afk again, then delete the old ## Autopilot section by hand.
session-hygiene is now tidy. The old name works only when typed; instruction files must name tidy. /setup check lists each old name with its new one.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the session-start and metrics hooks changed.
After a Claude Code or Codex update, the probes and /setup check say "program changed since setup" and refuse that program until you re-confirm its new path with the quota setup.
Reading the current session's context size on request uses the Claude Code or Codex program confirmed in the quota setup; set that up first.
After a merge, worktree_sweep.py list shows which worktrees are safe to remove, and on Claude Code a hook reminds you after gh pr merge; git's own checks do the removal.
/afk start now prints a goal to type into /goal before you leave, and on Claude Code starts a /loop while work waits on CI, reviews or a delegated run.
The main checkout stays on the default branch: branches are cut in worktrees, and session start says when the main checkout is on another branch.
On Claude Code, type /finolabs-vibecode:help and /finolabs-vibecode:status in full; /help and /status are the host's own commands.
